layout.infoBand: y 230-520 over wallpaper, plum frosted glass cards
layout.captions: y 900-1080, chest area, between face and hands

font: Tajawal (Bold 700 captions, ExtraBold 800 keywords, Medium 500 labels)

global.video: Lanczos upscale 720x1280 -> 1080x1920, light sharpen, no color change
global.audio: highpass 80Hz + light afftdn denoise + loudnorm -14 LUFS; no music
global.captions: Dynamic 2-4 word groups, active word in #E2178D with slight scale-up, synced to word timestamps
global.sfx: Soft whoosh / tick / pop generated locally, -24 dB under voice

beats.visual: HOOK: slow push-in 1.00->1.06 on face; keyword 'يوميًا' kinetic pop in info band with calendar icon, 7 day dots light up in sequence

beats.speech: من الساعة الثالثة إلى الساعة التاسعة
beats.visual: Clock card: hand sweeps from 3 to 9 in sync with 'الثالثة' then 'التاسعة'; animated numbers 3:00 -> 9:00
beats.motion: hand rotation eased to word timings; numbers count

beats.visual: Location card: logo mark (from supplied JPG, unaltered, on plum glass) + 'عيادات القمة' then map pin drops on 'القادسية'
beats.motion: card slides from right with mask reveal; pin bounce

beats.visual: Lower third in info band: 'د. زيد نوري الشريفي' + 'طبيب أسنان' with magenta accent line
beats.motion: line draws, name mask-wipes RTL, title fades up

beats.speech: على متابعة حالات التقويم أول بأول
beats.visual: Line-art SVG of upper tooth row with orthodontic brackets + wire drawing on (clean, schematic). Keyword 'التقويم' highlighted. 'أول بأول' = 3 follow-up dots on a timeline filling one by one
beats.motion: stroke draw-on 20 frames, brackets pop sequentially, timeline dots on 'أول' and 'بأول'

beats.visual: BREATHING SPACE: info band clears, captions only, very slow zoom continues
End card: logo (original colors/proportions) rises in info band; slogan 'القمة.. اختياركم صحيح' word-synced with magenta sweep under 'اختياركم'. Captions hide
beats.motion: logo fade+scale 0.9->1, soft glow; slogan per-word reveal

pendingConfirmations: 3 and 9 shown as numbers without عصرًا/مساءً unless you confirm
